lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨਾ ਸਫਲ ਜੀਵਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevanaa saphal jeevan sun har jap jap sad jeevanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Fruitful is the life, the life of one who hears about the Lord, and chants and meditates on Him; he lives forever. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੀਵਨਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਘਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: peevanaa jit man aaghaavai naam a(n)mrit ras peevanaa ||1||
lines.translation: The real drink is that which satisfies the mind; this drink is the sublime essence of the Ambrosial Naam. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਵਨਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਵਨਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: khaavanaa jit bhookh na laagai sa(n)tokh sadaa tripateevanaa ||2||
lines.translation: The real food is that which will never leave you hungry again; it will leave you contented and satisfied forever. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੈਨਣਾ ਰਖੁ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾਗੇ ਨਹੀ ਥੀਵਨਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: painanaa rakh pat paramesur phir naage nahee theevanaa ||3||
lines.translation: The real clothes are those which protect your honor before the Transcendent Lord, and do not leave you naked ever again. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੋਗਨਾ ਮਨ ਮਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਲੀਵਨਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: bhoganaa man madhe har ras sa(n)tasa(n)gat mahi leevanaa ||4||
lines.translation: The real enjoyment within the mind is to be absorbed in the sublime essence of the Lord, in the Society of the Saints. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਤਾਗੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੂਈ ਆਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੀਵਨਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: bin taage bin sooee aanee man har bhagatee sa(n)g seevanaa ||5||
lines.translation: Sew devotional worship to the Lord into the mind, without any needle or thread. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਅਉਖੀਵਨਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: maatiaa har ras mahi raate tis bahuR na kabahoo aukheevanaa ||6||
lines.translation: Imbued and intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord, this experience will never wear off again. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿਓ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੀਵਨਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: milio tis sarab nidhaanaa prabh kripaal jis deevanaa ||7||
lines.translation: One is blessed with all treasures, when God, in His Mercy, gives them. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਰਣ ਸੰਤ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਨਾ ॥੮॥੩॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: sukh naanak sa(n)tan kee sevaa charan sa(n)t dhoi peevanaa ||8||3||6||
lines.translation: O Nanak, service to the Saints beings peace; I drink in the wash water of the feet of the Saints. ||8||3||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਅੰਜੁਲੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ghar 8 a(n)juleeaa ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Eighth House, Anjulees ~ With Hands Cupped In Prayer:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis grihi bahut tisai grihi chi(n)taa ||
lines.translation: The household which is filled with abundance - that household suffers anxiety.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਥੋਰੀ ਸੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis grihi thoree s phirai bhrama(n)taa ||
lines.translation: One whose household has little, wanders around searching for more.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਹੂ ਬਿਵਸਥਾ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਭਾਲੀਐ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: duhoo bivasathaa te jo mukataa soee suhelaa bhaaleeai ||1||
lines.translation: He alone is happy and at peace, who is liberated from both conditions. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਰਾਜ ਮਹਿ ਨਰਕੁ ਉਦਾਸ ਕਰੋਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: grih raaj mahi narak udaas karodhaa ||
lines.translation: Householders and kings fall into hell, along with renunciates and angry men,

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬੇਦ ਪਾਠ ਸਭਿ ਸੋਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahu bidh bed paath sabh sodhaa ||
lines.translation: and all those who study and recite the Vedas in so many ways.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਜੋ ਰਹੈ ਅਲਿਪਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲੀਐ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: dehee mahi jo rahai alipataa tis jan kee pooran ghaaleeai ||2||
lines.translation: Perfect is the work of that humble servant, who remains unattached while in the body. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਤ ਸੂਤਾ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਗੂਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaagat sootaa bharam vigootaa ||
lines.translation: The mortal sleeps, even while he is awake; he is being plundered by doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈਐ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur mukat na hoeeai meetaa ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, liberation is not obtained, friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਟਹਿ ਹਉ ਬੰਧਨ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g tutahi hau ba(n)dhan eko ek nihaaleeai ||3||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the bonds of egotism are released, and one comes to behold the One and only Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਤ ਬੰਧਾ ਨਹ ਕਰੈ ਤ ਨਿੰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: karam karai ta ba(n)dhaa nah karai ta ni(n)daa ||
lines.translation: Doing deeds, one is placed in bondage; but if he does not act, he is slandered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਮਨੁ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਚਿੰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: moh magan man viaapiaa chi(n)daa ||
lines.translation: Intoxicated with emotional attachment, the mind is afflicted with anxiety.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਜਾਣੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਿਆਲੀਐ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: gur prasaad sukh dukh sam jaanai ghat ghat raam hiaaleeai ||4||
lines.translation: One who looks alike upon pleasure and pain, by Guru's Grace, sees the Lord in each and every heart. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ਮਹਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)saarai mahi sahasaa biaapai ||
lines.translation: Within the world, one is afflicted by skepticism;

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: akath kathaa agochar nahee jaapai ||
lines.translation: he does not know the imperceptible Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਓਹੁ ਬਾਲਕ ਵਾਗੀ ਪਾਲੀਐ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jisahi bujhaae soee boojhai ohu baalak vaagee paaleeai ||5||
lines.translation: He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand. The Lord cherishes him as His child. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਬਹੈ ਤਉ ਛੂਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhod bahai tau chhootai naahee ||
lines.translation: He may try to abandon Maya, but he is not released.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਸੰਚੈ ਤਉ ਭਉ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jau sa(n)chai tau bhau man maahee ||
lines.translation: If he collects things, then his mind is afraid of losing them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਉਰੁ ਢਾਲੀਐ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: is hee mahi jis kee pat raakhai tis saadhoo chaur dhaaleeai ||6||
lines.translation: I wave the fly-brush over that holy person, whose honor is protected in the midst of Maya. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo sooraa tis hee hoi maranaa ||
lines.translation: He alone is a warrior hero, who remains dead to the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਭਾਗੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਫਿਰਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo bhaagai tis jonee phiranaa ||
lines.translation: One who runs away will wander in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਵਰਤਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨੈ ਬੁਝਿ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਲੀਐ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: jo varataae soee bhal maanai bujh hukamai duramat jaaleeai ||7||
lines.translation: Whatever happens, accept that as good. Realize the Hukam of His Command, and your evil-mindedness will be burnt away. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit jit laavahi tit tit laganaa ||
lines.translation: Whatever He links us to, to that we are linked.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਅਪਣੇ ਜਚਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kar vekhai apane jachanaa ||
lines.translation: He acts, and does, and watches over His Creation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ॥੮॥੧॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ke pooran sukhadaate too dehi ta naam samaaleeai ||8||1||7||
lines.translation: You are the Giver of peace, the Perfect Lord of Nanak; as You grant Your blessings, I dwell upon Your Name. ||8||1||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਖੈ ਹੇਠਿ ਸਭਿ ਜੰਤ ਇਕਠੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: birakhai heth sabh ja(n)t ikathe ||
lines.translation: Beneath the tree, all beings have gathered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਤਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਮਿਠੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik tate ik bolan mithe ||
lines.translation: Some are hot-headed, and some speak very sweetly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਸਤੁ ਉਦੋਤੁ ਭਇਆ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੇ ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਅਉਧ ਵਿਹਾਣੀਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: asat udot bhaiaa uth chale jiu jiu audh vihaaneeaa ||1||
lines.translation: Sunset has come, and they rise up and depart; their days have run their course and expired. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਕਰੇਦੜ ਸਰਪਰ ਮੁਠੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paap karedaR sarapar muthe ||
lines.translation: Those who committed sins are sure to be ruined.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਜਰਾਈਲਿ ਫੜੇ ਫੜਿ ਕੁਠੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ajaraaeel phaRe phaR kuthe ||
lines.translation: Azraa-eel, the Angel of Death, seizes and tortures them.
